evidence.rowLabel: Net Income Attributable to Common Shareholders
evidence.paragraph: For the three months ended September 30, 2025, Net Income Attributable to Common Shareholders was $106.0 million, or $0.58 per diluted share, compared to Net Income Attributable to Common Shareholders of $98.1 million, or $0.54 per diluted share, for the same period in 2024.
